blocos.titulo: Some things to keep in mind while playing Akali

partes.texto: This champion is extremely early/midgame focused. you have to do well early and put your lead on your team to win games You don't have heavy loosing lane matchups mostly. champions are more "thematically" countering you, and making your life a living hell. a great example is galio, who you might be able to solokill once or twice if they aren't playing super well but you will have a hard time playing the game in every single fight because of his W in your shroud and his ult in later teamfights.

Akali's biggest cap: being an energy champion. she is a very unique champion in that she is gated by energy, which you can't increase in any way outside of getting bluebuff. this means that high hp and magic resist targets will always be a pain to deal with, unless you are extremely fed,

When is Akali strong in a draft? good generic indicators are being solo or max duo AP ( don't consider supports as too much AP, but at the same time take into account that enemy team will build more mercurys treads the more CC you have which will give them MR despite them not building against magic damage that heavily.
And when enemy is rather squishy. Champions that have a hard time fitting a ruby crystal or a nullmagic mantle into their builds even at 2-3 items are the best for Akali to play against.

Wincondition? Playing for drakes is the most straight forward easiest Akali wincondition. i know it sounds a bit weird but since Akali can't hit epic monsters or towers by herself to great effectiveness, her best way to win and close out games is by carrying thoose dragon fights, making sure you get to soul, and then you just overpower most champions in the game. This doesn't mean you should overforce every drakefight, be a bit flexible! but most of your wins will come by this being your main approach, since most champions outscale you  in 30+minute games, but soul makes you keep up with them way better!

partes.texto:
Why Only Electrocute+resolve?
Imo every systematic change since 2022 pushed Akali into being unable to play any other rune. Conqueror and fleet are just bad every single matchup, other keystones
don't even exist for her. for secondary runes she has once again no real options, as the stuff she needed(tenacity, lane survival, energy regen) got taken out of the rune
trees completely over the years.

What is changeable?
Relentless hunter you can take over ultimate, it used to be good but i think with the new homeguards ultimate hunter value goes up and its actually correct to take now.
Out of Resolve you can take conditioning if the matchup is free, Second wind is if its a poke lane, and Boneplating if the opponent has a hard time proccing it without
dealing multiple instances of damage at the same time.

WHY NO SORCERY NIMBUS+SCORCH?
Nimbus on Akali is fake and bad. its good on some AD assasins(talon, zed, and especially naafiri) because they can get in some more autoattacks when they are cheesing
in earlygame, but Akali autos tickle you, she doesn't have enough ad for it, and thus you only take it for Scorch. scorch is a good rune vs other meele mids that you can Q
often, but since there is no good 2nd rune option i rather go resolve and be more tanky/durable. I take scorch+absolute focus in exactly 1 matchup and that is Yasuo,
because of a special interaction of taking down his passive shield with Q and then the scorch proccing his boneplating being actually a high value rune for that reason.

WHY NO PRESENCE OF MIND FOR ENERGY?
It is completely fake, doesn't really give you energy if you do the math on how energy regens and how it interact with Akali and check the numbers on it, it basically gives you
nothing outside of when you kill people. the passive when you hit someone gets wasted 0-24 and is never useful, it never makes the difference. The on kill effect is okayish,
but other runes do more for you, it really doesn't pull its weight giving you half a Q on every kill is not woth it.

I SEE FAKER PICK UNFLINCHING, WHY NO UNFLINCHING?
Unflinching is good when you are minmaxing your earlygame because you think enemy laner is going to play well, but trust me, unless you are high challenger playing
against the best otps of certain champions overgrowth is better, as the lower the rank the less punished you get and the longer the games go, and unflinching is just  there
for laning phase, meanwhile overgrowth scales up really nicely into the midgame/lategame.

SHARDS:
Tenacity shard really good in combination with mercs, so if its a mercs game go for it, take scaling HP from middle and always adaptive on top.
MS shard is good in matchups where you don't need the adaptive damage or the tenacity shard( can't take ms+tenacity imo, i always like 1 HP shard atleast for combat)
as  you are killing them anyways if you get in range. Example:vel'koz, orianna, viktor, Yone, etc. where spacing matters.
Double adapative: in matchups that are always in your face you Q them on cooldown. on midlane Sylas is a prime example, maybe yasuo, and most toplane matchups.

FLAT HP VS SCALING HP:
If you ask me Scaling Hp always. pro players like to take scaling hp, and high elo players, but unless you are one of thoose you should be completely fine with scaling HP
earlygame, and you will be scaling a lot better into the mid/lategame without getting oneshot as much. Also the combination of scaling HP and overgrowth gives around 300+
HP midgame, which is almost as much as what rocketbelt gave you, so you effectively have that tankiness while building full dmg, and thats without calculating in gunblades 
healings effective health. The lower rank you are the longer your games are on average statistically, so please believe me, scaling HP is the way to go, flat HP is a scam.

-Really good earlygame into mages, and you will see me sit on this on toplane
even at 25-30 mins. Why? tier2 boots are way too stat inefficient, and you

to purchase vs toplane champs as its good vs lower MR targets.

how good you are doing on your quest. No matter what tier3 boots you have
you should always go for them as soon as quest is done/have them done by then.
Just generic best boots if no need for the others.

Anytime you need tenacity for the game and MR is generally good in the game
theese boots are really good even post nerf. just not an autobuy anymore.

Would say most situational, but when you need Defensive stats over offensive
and enemy comp is heavy AD i think its still good on Akali even if its not uber

Worst item in the game for Akali, huge bait, never buy. In its current form this item
is only usable on scaling champions, like riven and adcs sadly. Having to invest
money into 0 offensive stats for not that much healing, and then having to get
+10 kills to fully activate the item is really just awful. It was playable on the release
patch, but got gutted really fast :/

Every single game first item no questions asked. No but really, great buildpath
is something Akali was missing for a long time now, and this has it. Akali has
great AD scalings on her spells aswell, so its perfect for her with a great active.
Healing part is pretty placebo because its 1/3rd of what it was pre season11.

Akalis best 2nd item when going burst. Provides similar damage to Shadowflame
all while having an easier buildpath, less cost, and movement speed on top of it
just basically a better shadowflame as of now.

This item is pretty good when not buying mpen boots,the buildpath sucks but that
matters way less when purchasing as a 2nd item.feels great into tankier 
opponents overall, value goes up when you go defensive boots as you play
for longer fights with thoose boots anyways, and less for burst.
can still buy with mpen boots anyways if you want gigadamage vs hp/mr stackers

This item is buyable when you want more damage as 2nd, sadly this and

Akali's 2nd best item, but because of the buildpath you usually go for it later on.
If you manage to get a largerod recall for shadowflame, and you have money
for another largerod on the nextone you can pivot into this instead.
yes its already better as a 2nd item than shadow, the buildpath is the reason you
don't see it perma as a 2nd item.

Another one of Akalis huge favourites, If opponents have above 60MR on average
its already great value. synergies well with flatpen aswell, its just one of the best
items all around. Buildpath sucks tho, but mandatory in every fullbuild, just like
rabadon/gunblade.

Another huge favourite, great as a defensive tool, and as an agressive one aswell
you can zhonya while E2ing to guarantee not get your E2 canceled by CC.
Another neat trick with zhonya is not building out the item and sitting on seekers
as long as you have the active. this does 2 things: 1: it allows you to buy largerod
and then start building into another item if you don't end up using your seekers
you might end up going for rabadon instead of finishing it and still have the 
active. and on top of it you can use seekers->recall->buy zhonya you have 
another zhonya without it being on a 120second cooldown. this cd is very long
and is even better if you have TP. you can legit fight zhonya get out buy zhonya
and TP back to fight and have another surprise zhonya that people never 
expect even in highelo. 99%part of your fullbuild, insane item.

partes.texto: Won't be listing out more of them individually, as this is mostly your build, only 2nd item changes and ordering. probably the most asked items
will be outside of theese:
Why no rocketbelt: buildpath sucks,buying haste sucks, champ can't use  that stat and overall underwhelming.. we have better options now.
Morello: Never buy this, maybe oblivion orb in certain matchups but i would say thoose matchups are extremely thin, but will be on the spread
sheet if you need it. otherwise ignite is your healing reduction
Banshee: buildpath sucks stats suck effect sucks overall item value is very low, maybe 1 out of 20 games you can buy it and not feel bad, but
its rather slim. even against ap champs you will end up going zhonyas a lot more, the real anti magic item is definitely just mercurys treads.
QSS: very rarely buyable, only useful vs supressions that tenacity doesn't effect/can't be cleansed(malza ult, ww ult, urgot ult) but
even in thoose situations i wouldn't personally buy it, i  think having my team cancel thoose spells and me having that gold invested into
something else is better. with that said if you have 1.3k gold and you think its going to win you the game go for it against them.
